canonical.title: Unbounded Knapsack
canonical.sourceFilePath: 14. Dynamic Programming/4. DP on Subsequences/10. Unbounded Knapsack.cpp

narrative.title: The Wholesale Pallet Buyer
narrative.scenario: A distributor loads a delivery van with stock items — each SKU has a boxed weight and a resale margin, and the storeroom holds unlimited copies of every SKU. The van has a hard axle limit W. The buyer's terminal must pick the basket of SKUs (repeats allowed) that maximizes margin without exceeding the limit.
narrative.inputFormat: Integers n and W, plus arrays wt and val of length n giving each SKU's weight and value.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the maximum total value with total weight at most W, where any item may be taken any number of times.

testCases.explanation: Load the weight-1 item three times — total 3 within the limit.
Four copies of the weight-2 SKU load the van to exactly 8 for 4 * 3 = 12.

hintLevels: Level 1: Identical to 0-1 knapsack except taking an item leaves you on the same item.
Level 2: best[i][w] = max(best[i-1][w], val[i] + best[i][w - wt[i]]) — note the same-row lookback.
Level 3: A 1D sweep left-to-right encodes the unbounded re-use automatically; right-to-left would forbid it.
